style: a calm, confident product-demo narrator, clear and friendly, unhurried, slight warmth

lines.text: Everyone listens to someone about markets. An analyst, a loud account, a friend in a group chat, their own gut. They all sound sure. Nobody keeps score. Hindsight does.

Hindsight is a pick journal with a long-term memory. Tatum prices and scores every call. Walrus Memory, on Sui mainnet, remembers every call, outcome and lesson. And what it remembers decides whom you should trust.
Here is a tip from Uncle Raj: ETH closes higher within a week, eighty percent sure. Hindsight prices it through Tatum the moment it is logged, and writes it to Walrus.
When a deadline passes, Tatum's live price marks the call right or wrong. Every result becomes a plain-English memory on Walrus, and every write leaves a receipt with its blob ID on mainnet.

From those outcomes, Hindsight learns a trust score for each voice. The careful analyst climbs. The loud bull who is always ninety-nine percent sure sinks to four percent, because confident misses cost the most.
Before you log the next call, Hindsight recalls that voice's history from Walrus, and the memory analyst gives a one-line verdict. Here: give this voice very little weight on SUI.
The crowd leans bullish on SUI. Weighted by what memory knows about each voice, the view flips to bearish, and Hindsight flags it.

Patterns become lessons: losing streaks, weak assets, overconfidence. Then Hindsight reflects. It reads its own memories back from Walrus, finds patterns across voices, and writes new insights back to memory.
Ask in plain words, like: who keeps getting SUI wrong? The answer comes only from memories recalled from Walrus, and every claim links to its source.
Delete the local database, and trust can be rebuilt from Walrus alone. The memory is portable. Voices can even link a Sui wallet, read through Tatum's Sui gateway, to show their skin in the game.
Under the hood: Tatum's Data API and Sui RPC for prices and on-chain reads, Walrus Memory for everything Hindsight learns, and an analyst that only speaks from what memory recalls.
Hindsight. The pick journal that remembers who was right. Open source, built on Tatum and Walrus.
